blocks.en: Annex H, Part 2: Advanced IVD Risk Management Content and the Complete Bibliography

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握IVD事件序列分析（H.2.6）的三層結構：製造商控制層、實驗室用戶層、臨床醫師層
blocks.en: Understand the three-layer structure of IVD event sequence analysis (H.2.6): manufacturer control, laboratory user, and clinician

blocks.zh: 理解P1×P2機率分段估算法，對複雜IVD風險場景的應用價值
blocks.en: Understand the value of the P1 × P2 split probability estimation method for complex IVD risk scenarios

blocks.zh: 識別H.2.7.3的8類概率評估問題，用於分析性與臨床兩個環節
blocks.en: Recognize the eight probability estimation questions in H.2.7.3, which cover both the analytical and the clinical stages

blocks.zh: 掌握IVD風險控制三層次：固有安全設計 → 安全資訊 → 培訓教育
blocks.en: Understand the three tiers of IVD risk control: inherently safe design → information for safety → training and education

blocks.zh: 理解效益-風險分析對IVD替代終點（surrogate endpoints）的應用
blocks.en: Understand how benefit-risk analysis applies to IVD surrogate endpoints

blocks.zh: 建立ISO/TR 24971參考書目的互連脈絡：從設計管制到法規送審
blocks.en: Build the interconnected picture of the ISO/TR 24971 bibliography: from design controls to regulatory submission

blocks.zh:
H.2.6 Identification of IVD Sequences of Events Leading to Hazardous Situations
識別導致危險情況的IVD事件序列
blocks.en:
H.2.6 Identification of IVD Sequences of Events Leading to Hazardous Situations
Identifying IVD event sequences that lead to hazardous situations

blocks.zh:
教學解析：IVD事件序列的三層結構
Three-Layer Event Sequence
blocks.en:
Teaching Analysis: The Three-Layer Structure of IVD Event Sequences
Three-Layer Event Sequence

blocks.zh: 關鍵概念：IVD風險不止於儀器故障
blocks.en: Key Concept: IVD Risk Does Not Stop at Instrument Failure

blocks.zh: 一般醫療器械的風險分析可能只需考慮設備本身的故障模式。但IVD的風險序列橫跨三個控制域，製造商只能直接管控第一層。
blocks.en: For a general medical device, risk analysis may only need to consider the failure modes of the device itself. For IVDs, however, the risk sequence spans three domains of control, and the manufacturer can directly control only the first.

blocks.zh: 第一層（製造商控制）：設計缺陷、標籤錯誤、製程不穩定 — 製造商完全責任
blocks.en: Layer 1 (manufacturer control): design defects, labeling errors, unstable processes. The manufacturer is fully responsible.

blocks.zh: 第二層（實驗室/使用者控制）：樣品採集、QC操作、結果回報 — 製造商透過標籤與培訓間接影響
blocks.en: Layer 2 (laboratory/user control): sample collection, QC operations, result reporting. The manufacturer influences this layer only indirectly, through labeling and training.

blocks.zh: 第三層（臨床醫師控制）：診斷決策、治療選擇 — 超出ISO 14971管轄範圍
blocks.en: Layer 3 (clinician control): diagnostic decisions and treatment choices. These fall outside the scope of ISO 14971.

blocks.zh: CDMO視角：若你為IVD試劑盒做代工，你的風險分析必須延伸到「錯誤結果傳到醫師手中」的那一刻，即使實驗室操作不在你的直接控制之下。
blocks.en: CDMO perspective: if you contract-manufacture an IVD test kit, your risk analysis must extend to the moment an erroneous result reaches the physician, even though laboratory operations are not under your direct control.

blocks.zh: 類比：血糖試片的完整風險鏈
blocks.en: Analogy: The Complete Risk Chain for a Blood Glucose Test Strip

blocks.zh: 想像你製造家用血糖試片。風險鏈如下：
blocks.en: Imagine you manufacture home-use blood glucose test strips. The risk chain looks like this:

blocks.zh: 試片批次校準值偏高（製造商控制層）
blocks.en: The calibration value of a strip lot is set too high (manufacturer control layer)

blocks.zh: 患者在過期後使用試片（使用者控制層）
blocks.en: The patient uses a strip after its expiry (user control layer)

blocks.zh: 血糖顯示偏高，患者注射額外胰島素（臨床決策層）
blocks.en: The meter shows a falsely high glucose reading, and the patient injects extra insulin (clinical decision layer)

blocks.zh: 患者陷入低血糖昏迷（傷害 Harm）
blocks.en: The patient falls into a hypoglycemic coma (Harm)

blocks.zh: 在這條鏈中，製造商的風險控制著力點主要在第1步，但也必須透過IFU警告、效期標示與校準訓練延伸影響第2步。
blocks.en: In this chain, the manufacturer's risk control leverage lies mainly in step 1, but it must also extend its influence to step 2 through IFU warnings, expiry date labeling, and calibration training.

blocks.zh: 實驗室獨立驗錯機制的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of Independent Error Detection in the Laboratory

blocks.zh: H.2.6.1 特別提醒：醫學實驗室有流程設計用來偵測錯誤，但隨機性故障（sporadic random failures）特別難被偵測。如果一個錯誤結果看起來「合理」，有經驗的臨床醫師也可能接受它並據此做出治療決定。
blocks.en: H.2.6.1 special reminder: medical laboratories have processes designed to detect errors, but sporadic random failures are especially hard to detect. If an erroneous result looks "plausible", even an experienced clinician may accept it and base a treatment decision on it.

blocks.zh: 對CDMO而言：這意味著即使實驗室QC流程存在，也不能作為減少製造端風險的理由。製造品質本身就是第一道防線。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this means that the existence of laboratory QC processes can never be used as a reason to reduce risk controls on the manufacturing side. Manufacturing quality itself is the first line of defense.

blocks.zh:
H.2.7 Estimation of the Probability of Occurrence of Harm
傷害發生概率之估算
blocks.en:
H.2.7 Estimation of the Probability of Occurrence of Harm
Estimating the probability of occurrence of harm

blocks.zh:
教學解析：P1×P2分段估算法的實用性
Why Split the Probability Estimation?
blocks.en:
Teaching Analysis: Why the P1 × P2 Split Estimation Is Practical
Why Split the Probability Estimation?

blocks.zh: P1×P2：讓正確的人估算正確的部分
blocks.en: P1 × P2: Letting the Right People Estimate the Right Part

blocks.zh: 一個IVD錯誤結果到最終造成病患傷害，需要穿越兩個截然不同的知識領域：
blocks.en: For an erroneous IVD result to end up harming a patient, it must pass through two very different areas of knowledge:

blocks.zh: P1（技術領域）：儀器工程師、試劑化學師、QC人員 — 他們了解設備如何失效
blocks.en: P1 (technical domain): instrument engineers, reagent chemists, QC staff. They understand how the equipment fails.

blocks.zh: P2（臨床領域）：臨床醫師、醫學顧問 — 他們了解錯誤結果在臨床上的後果
blocks.en: P2 (clinical domain): clinicians and medical advisors. They understand the clinical consequences of an erroneous result.

blocks.zh: 讓同一個跨功能團隊評估整條鏈是低效且不準確的。P1×P2的拆分讓每個專家只評估自己有能力判斷的部分。
blocks.en: Having a single cross-functional team assess the whole chain is inefficient and inaccurate. The P1 × P2 split lets each expert assess only the part they are competent to judge.

blocks.zh: 類比：葡萄糖分析儀案例（圖H.1）
blocks.en: Analogy: The Glucose Analyzer Case (Figure H.1)

blocks.zh: 血液葡萄糖分析儀因校準值指定錯誤，導致偏高結果被報告給臨床醫師：
blocks.en: A blood glucose analyzer is assigned an incorrect calibration value, so falsely high results are reported to clinicians:

blocks.zh: P1估算：技術團隊評估校準值偏離的頻率、QC能否截獲、系統警報的有效性
blocks.en: P1 estimate: the technical team assesses how often the calibration value deviates, whether QC can intercept the error, and how effective the system alarms are.

blocks.zh: 危險情況定義：「錯誤結果被報告給臨床醫師」這一刻
blocks.en: Definition of the hazardous situation: the moment when "an erroneous result is reported to the clinician".

blocks.zh: P2估算：臨床顧問評估醫師接受偏高血糖結果的概率、是否會調整胰島素劑量
blocks.en: P2 estimate: the clinical advisor assesses the probability that a physician accepts a falsely high glucose result and whether the insulin dose would be adjusted.

blocks.zh: 最終傷害概率 = P1 × P2（兩個獨立專家評估的乘積）
blocks.en: Final probability of harm = P1 × P2 (the product of two estimates made independently by two different experts)

blocks.zh: Table H.1的8個問題：實務應用重點
blocks.en: The Eight Questions in Table H.1: Practical Points

blocks.zh: Q2（QC攔截能力）是最關鍵的P1問題：若常規QC材料能偵測到批次偏差，P1大幅降低；若故障是間歇性的（如電子元件接觸不良），QC幾乎無法攔截，P1偏高。
blocks.en: Q2 (ability of QC to intercept) is the most critical P1 question: if routine QC materials can detect a lot deviation, P1 drops substantially; if the failure is intermittent (for example, a poor electrical contact), QC can hardly intercept it and P1 stays high.

blocks.zh: Q5（臨床醫師識別能力）是最關鍵的P2問題：若錯誤結果在生理上「合理」（例如糖尿病患者血糖偏高），醫師不會質疑；若結果明顯荒謬（例如健康人血鉀9.0 mmol/L），醫師通常會要求重測，P2降低。
blocks.en: Q5 (clinician's ability to recognize the error) is the most critical P2 question: if the erroneous result is physiologically "plausible" (for example, a high glucose value in a diabetic patient), the physician will not question it; if the result is obviously absurd (for example, serum potassium of 9.0 mmol/L in a healthy person), the physician will usually request a retest, and P2 is lower.

blocks.zh: CDMO應用：為客戶的IVD產品做風險分析審查時，確認這8個問題都有對應的文件記錄與合理的概率估算。
blocks.en: CDMO application: when reviewing a client's IVD risk analysis, confirm that all eight questions have corresponding documented records and reasonable probability estimates.

blocks.zh: 注意：點照護（POC）裝置的分析簡化
blocks.en: Note: Simplified Analysis for Point-of-Care (POC) Devices

blocks.zh: H.2.7.1指出，對於短事件序列（如自我測試、POC裝置），整條鏈可由一個跨功能團隊統一分析，不必強制拆分P1×P2。判斷標準是：事件序列是否複雜到需要不同領域專家分別評估。對於CDMO代工的簡單快篩試劑，統一分析往往已足夠。
blocks.en: H.2.7.1 points out that for short event sequences (such as self-testing and POC devices), the whole chain can be analyzed by a single cross-functional team, and the P1 × P2 split is not mandatory. The criterion is whether the event sequence is complex enough to require experts from different domains to assess it separately. For the simple rapid test kits a CDMO typically manufactures under contract, a unified analysis is often sufficient.

blocks.zh:
H.3 Risk Control for IVD Medical Devices
IVD醫療器械的風險控制
blocks.en:
H.3 Risk Control for IVD Medical Devices
Risk control for IVD medical devices

blocks.zh:
教學解析：IVD風險控制三層次
Three Tiers of IVD Risk Control
blocks.en:
Teaching Analysis: The Three Tiers of IVD Risk Control
Three Tiers of IVD Risk Control

blocks.zh: 風險控制優先層次（同一般醫療器械，但IVD特色鮮明）
blocks.en: Risk Control Priority Order (Same as for General Medical Devices, but with Distinct IVD Features)

blocks.zh: ISO 14971的風險控制層次對IVD完全適用，但每一層的具體措施有IVD的獨特性：
blocks.en: The ISO 14971 risk control hierarchy applies fully to IVDs, but the specific measures at each tier have IVD-specific characteristics:

blocks.zh: 第一層：固有安全設計 — 試劑配方的分析特異性、校準值的計量溯源性、儀器的內建偵錯系統。這些措施直接消除或降低P1。
blocks.en: Tier 1: Inherently safe design: the analytical specificity of the reagent formulation, the metrological traceability of calibrator values, and the instrument's built-in error detection. These measures directly eliminate or reduce P1.

blocks.zh: 第二層：保護措施 — 液位感應器、樣品品質偵測（溶血偵測）、條碼核對系統。這些是製造端的工程防護，獨立於用戶行為。
blocks.en: Tier 2: Protective measures: liquid level sensors, sample quality detection (hemolysis detection), and barcode verification systems. These are engineering safeguards on the manufacturing side and are independent of user behavior.

blocks.zh: 第三層：安全資訊 — IFU中的警告、干擾物質清單、樣品類型限制。只有當前兩層無法完全控制風險時才使用。
blocks.en: Tier 3: Information for safety: IFU warnings, lists of interfering substances, and sample type restrictions. Use these only when the first two tiers cannot fully control the risk.

blocks.zh: 注意：H.3.4特別提醒，建議實驗室用戶執行的QC檢測、確認性測試或緊急值通知，屬於「安全資訊」，而非「保護措施」。
blocks.en: Note: H.3.4 specifically reminds us that QC testing, confirmatory testing, or critical-value notification that is recommended to laboratory users counts as "information for safety", not as a "protective measure".

blocks.zh: CDMO IVD代工的四大製造風險
blocks.en: The Four Major Manufacturing Risks in CDMO IVD Contract Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 在CDMO廠房中，IVD試劑盒的製造風險直接對應到H.3.2的設計特性：
blocks.en: In a CDMO facility, the manufacturing risks of an IVD kit map directly to the design characteristics in H.3.2:

blocks.zh: 試劑穩定性：配方或儲存條件不當 → 批次效期縮短 → 校準值漂移 → 患者結果偏差
blocks.en: Reagent stability: inappropriate formulation or storage conditions → shortened lot shelf life → calibration drift → biased patient results

blocks.zh: 分裝精準度：填充量偏差 → 反應物比例異常 → 假陰性/假陽性
blocks.en: Dispensing accuracy: fill volume deviation → abnormal reactant ratios → false negatives/false positives

blocks.zh: 容器完整性：密封不良 → 水分滲入 → 試劑降解 → 靈敏度下降
blocks.en: Container integrity: poor sealing → moisture ingress → reagent degradation → reduced sensitivity

blocks.zh: 污染控制：交叉污染 → 特異性下降 → 假陽性（尤其核酸試劑）
blocks.en: Contamination control: cross-contamination → reduced specificity → false positives (especially for nucleic acid reagents)

blocks.zh: 這四項都直接影響P1，是CDMO的核心品質控制點。
blocks.en: All four directly affect P1 and are the core quality control points for a CDMO.

blocks.zh: 計量溯源性（Metrological Traceability）：IVD準確性的基礎
blocks.en: Metrological Traceability: The Foundation of IVD Accuracy

blocks.zh: H.3.2和H.3.5多次強調計量溯源性。ISO 17511定義了建立IVD校準值溯源到高階參考物質的流程。JCTLM（Joint Committee for Traceability in Laboratory Medicine）維護一個受認可的參考測量系統數據庫。
blocks.en: H.3.2 and H.3.5 repeatedly emphasize metrological traceability. ISO 17511 defines the process for establishing the traceability of IVD calibrator values to higher-order reference materials. The JCTLM (Joint Committee for Traceability in Laboratory Medicine) maintains a database of recognized reference measurement systems.

blocks.zh: 對CDMO：若你代工的IVD試劑使用了客戶指定的校準品，你需要確認該校準品是否已建立符合ISO 17511的溯源鏈。這是風險分析中「trueness of calibrator values」的文件基礎。
blocks.en: For a CDMO: if the IVD reagent you manufacture uses a calibrator specified by the client, you need to confirm that the calibrator has an ISO 17511-compliant traceability chain. This is the documentary basis for "trueness of calibrator values" in the risk analysis.

blocks.zh: 安全資訊的侷限：資訊不一定到達臨床醫師
blocks.en: Limits of Information for Safety: The Information May Not Reach the Clinician

blocks.zh: H.3.6末尾指出三個安全資訊的現實限制：
blocks.en: The end of H.3.6 points out three practical limitations of information for safety:

blocks.zh: 不同地區用戶的能力和使用環境差異極大
blocks.en: The competence and use environments of users differ enormously between regions

blocks.zh: 品質控制與品質保證的實踐在全球各地並不統一
blocks.en: The practice of quality control and quality assurance is not uniform around the world

blocks.zh: 提供給實驗室用戶的禁忌症和干擾藥物資訊，不一定能到達開具檢驗單的臨床醫師
blocks.en: Contraindication and interfering-drug information provided to laboratory users does not necessarily reach the clinician who orders the test

blocks.zh: 這意味著「提供安全資訊」的風險控制效力有上限，不能過度依賴，必須優先依靠設計端的固有安全措施。
blocks.en: This means the effectiveness of "providing information for safety" as a risk control has an upper limit. It must not be over-relied on, and priority must go to inherently safe design measures.

blocks.zh:
H.4–H.6 Benefit-Risk Analysis, Residual Risk Disclosure & Post-Production
效益-風險分析、殘餘風險揭露與上市後管理
blocks.en:
H.4–H.6 Benefit-Risk Analysis, Residual Risk Disclosure & Post-Production
Benefit-risk analysis, residual risk disclosure, and post-production management

blocks.zh:
教學解析：效益-風險、揭露與上市後監控
Benefit-Risk, Disclosure & PMS
blocks.en:
Teaching Analysis: Benefit-Risk, Disclosure and Post-Market Monitoring
Benefit-Risk, Disclosure & PMS

blocks.zh: IVD的「效益」如何量化？
blocks.en: How Is the "Benefit" of an IVD Quantified?

blocks.zh: 一般治療性器械的效益可以是「降低死亡率X%」或「縮短住院天數Y天」。但IVD的效益通常是間接的——它提供資訊，讓醫師做出更好的決策。
blocks.en: The benefit of a general therapeutic device can be expressed as "X% lower mortality" or "Y fewer hospital days". The benefit of an IVD, however, is usually indirect: it provides information that lets physicians make better decisions.

blocks.zh: H.4因此引入「替代終點（surrogate endpoints）」概念：
blocks.en: H.4 therefore introduces the concept of "surrogate endpoints":

blocks.zh: 直接效益難以量化時：改用「偵測特定疾病的能力（靈敏度/特異性）」作為代理指標
blocks.en: When direct benefit is hard to quantify: use "the ability to detect a specific disease (sensitivity/specificity)" as a proxy indicator.

blocks.zh: 範例：一個HbA1c測試的效益可以用「正確診斷糖尿病的概率」來表述，而不需要追蹤到「患者5年後的糖尿病控制結果」
blocks.en: Example: the benefit of an HbA1c test can be expressed as "the probability of correctly diagnosing diabetes", without having to track "the patient's diabetes control outcomes five years later".

blocks.zh: 這對監管申請中的效益宣稱寫法有直接影響，EU IVDR 2017/746要求明確陳述臨床效益。
blocks.en: This directly affects how benefit claims are written in regulatory submissions; EU IVDR 2017/746 requires the clinical benefit to be stated explicitly.

blocks.zh: 殘餘風險揭露 vs. 安全資訊：區別何在？
blocks.en: Residual Risk Disclosure vs. Information for Safety: What Is the Difference?

blocks.zh: H.5.1特別強調：殘餘風險的揭露是在安全資訊之外額外進行的。
blocks.en: H.5.1 emphasizes that disclosure of residual risk is done in addition to information for safety.

blocks.zh: 安全資訊（IFU中的警告）：「避免使用溶血樣品」→ 這是告訴用戶如何操作以降低風險
blocks.en: Information for safety (warnings in the IFU): "Avoid using hemolyzed samples". This tells users how to operate the device to reduce risk.

blocks.zh: 殘餘風險揭露（規格聲明中的限制）：「血紅素濃度>10 g/L時結果可能偏低20%」→ 這是告訴用戶即使正確操作，仍有哪些性能邊界
blocks.en: Residual risk disclosure (limitations in the specification statement): "When the hemoglobin concentration is >10 g/L, results may read up to 20% low". This tells users what performance limits remain even when the device is operated correctly.

blocks.zh: 對CDMO：在代工產品的技術文件審查中，確認客戶已區分這兩類文件，並確保殘餘風險揭露與風險管理檔案中的殘餘風險評估結果一致。
blocks.en: For a CDMO: when reviewing the technical documentation of a contract-manufactured product, confirm that the client has distinguished these two types of documents and that the residual risk disclosure is consistent with the residual risk evaluation results in the risk management file.

blocks.zh: IVD上市後監控的特殊挑戰
blocks.en: Special Challenges of IVD Post-Market Monitoring

blocks.zh: H.6.3揭示一個IVD特有的困境：醫學實驗室通常不知道一個回報的結果是錯誤的，除非後來收到臨床醫師的投訴。也就是說，「沒有投訴」不等於「沒有問題」。
blocks.en: H.6.3 reveals a dilemma specific to IVDs: a medical laboratory usually does not know that a reported result was wrong unless it later receives a complaint from a clinician. In other words, "no complaints" does not mean "no problems".

blocks.zh: 解決策略：
blocks.en: Strategies:

blocks.zh: 參加外部能力測試（proficiency testing programs）— 可以客觀評估系統性偏差
blocks.en: Take part in external proficiency testing programs, which can objectively assess systematic bias

blocks.zh: 主動監控類似產品的不良事件資料庫
blocks.en: Proactively monitor adverse event databases for similar products

blocks.zh: 建立傷害分類與編碼系統，在接收到投訴時快速判斷嚴重性
blocks.en: Establish a harm classification and coding system so that severity can be judged quickly when a complaint is received

blocks.zh:
H.7 Examples of Risk Scenarios for IVD Medical Devices
IVD風險場景案例
blocks.en:
H.7 Examples of Risk Scenarios for IVD Medical Devices
Examples of IVD risk scenarios

blocks.zh:

blocks.zh: 類比：從CDMO角度看三個場景
blocks.en: Analogy: The Three Scenarios from a CDMO Perspective

blocks.zh: 假設你的CDMO為三種不同IVD代工：
blocks.en: Suppose your CDMO manufactures three different kinds of IVDs under contract:

blocks.zh: 中央實驗室試劑盒：你的試劑製造品質決定P1（錯誤結果產生的概率），P2由客戶的臨床驗證數據支持
blocks.en: Central laboratory test kit: the quality of your reagent manufacturing determines P1 (the probability that an erroneous result is generated), while P2 is supported by the client's clinical validation data.

blocks.zh: 家用血糖試片：你的製造品質影響整條傷害鏈，因為用戶（患者）沒有QC機制；你需要確保設備極度耐用且結果直觀易讀
blocks.en: Home-use blood glucose test strip: your manufacturing quality affects the entire harm chain, because the user (the patient) has no QC mechanism; you must ensure the device is extremely robust and its results are intuitive and easy to read.

blocks.zh: 急診POC試劑：除了準確性，你還需要確保可靠性和結果時效性（availability）— 延誤本身就是一種傷害機制
blocks.en: Emergency POC reagent: besides accuracy, you also need to ensure reliability and timeliness of results (availability); a delay is itself a harm mechanism.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO代工IVD時的風險分析檢查清單
blocks.en: Practical Application: Risk Analysis Checklist for CDMO IVD Contract Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 確認客戶已定義預期用途（analyte種類、樣品類型、使用者族群、臨床情境：篩檢/診斷/監測）
blocks.en: Confirm that the client has defined the intended use (analyte type, sample type, user population, clinical setting: screening/diagnosis/monitoring)

blocks.zh: 識別三層事件序列中，哪些事件受你的製造品質直接影響（對應P1）
blocks.en: Identify which events in the three-layer event sequence are directly affected by your manufacturing quality (corresponding to P1)

blocks.zh: 確認試劑穩定性研究、分裝精準度驗證、容器完整性測試已納入設計輸出
blocks.en: Confirm that reagent stability studies, dispensing accuracy validation, and container integrity testing have been included in the design outputs

blocks.zh: 確認計量溯源性文件（校準品→參考標準→JCTLM数据库）已建立
blocks.en: Confirm that metrological traceability documentation (calibrator → reference standard → JCTLM database) has been established

blocks.zh: 確認上市後監控計劃包含外部能力測試（proficiency testing）的定期回顧
blocks.en: Confirm that the post-market surveillance plan includes periodic review of external proficiency testing

blocks.zh: 確認殘餘風險揭露文件與風險管理檔案中的殘餘風險評估結果一致
blocks.en: Confirm that the residual risk disclosure documents are consistent with the residual risk evaluation results in the risk management file

blocks.zh: 場景比較：為何分析方法不同？
blocks.en: Scenario Comparison: Why Do the Analytical Approaches Differ?

blocks.zh: 關鍵差異在於臨床決策鏈的複雜度：中央實驗室涉及實驗室-臨床醫師兩層，自我測試只有患者一層，POC介於兩者之間。
blocks.en: The key difference is the complexity of the clinical decision chain: the central laboratory involves two layers (laboratory and clinician), self-testing involves only one layer (the patient), and POC falls in between.

blocks.zh: CDMO的核心優勢：跨標準整合能力
blocks.en: The CDMO's Core Strength: Cross-Standard Integration Capability

blocks.zh: 參考書目中的40個標準反映了一個事實：現代醫療器械的風險管理不是單一標準能夠覆蓋的。對CDMO而言，能夠整合這些標準的能力本身就是競爭優勢。
blocks.en: The 40 standards in the bibliography reflect the fact that risk management for modern medical devices cannot be covered by any single standard. For a CDMO, the ability to integrate these standards is itself a competitive advantage.

blocks.zh: 具體體現在客戶選擇CDMO時的評估問題：
blocks.en: This shows up concretely in the questions clients ask when selecting a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 「你們的生產流程是否已整合ISO 14971的風險管理要求？」（ISO 13485 Cl.7.1驗證）
blocks.en: "Has your production process integrated the risk management requirements of ISO 14971?" (verified through ISO 13485 Cl. 7.1)

blocks.zh: 「你們的IVD試劑穩定性研究是否符合ISO 23640？」（書目[40]）
blocks.en: "Do your IVD reagent stability studies comply with ISO 23640?" (bibliography [40])

blocks.zh: 「對於預充填注射系統，你們如何管理針具安全和劑量準確性的風險？」（ISO 11608-1，書目[23]）
blocks.en: "For prefilled injection systems, how do you manage the risks of needle safety and dose accuracy?" (ISO 11608-1, bibliography [23])

blocks.zh: 從監管送審角度看標準互連
blocks.en: Standards Interconnection from the Regulatory Submission Perspective

blocks.zh: 以一個CDMO代工的combination product（如預充填抗體注射器）為例，完整的技術文件需要：
blocks.en: Take a combination product that a CDMO manufactures under contract (such as a prefilled antibody syringe). The complete technical documentation requires:

blocks.zh: ISO 14971 風險管理文件 — 整體架構（必須）
blocks.en: ISO 14971 risk management file: the overall framework (required)

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-1 生物評估報告 — 接觸材料的生物相容性（必須）
blocks.en: ISO 10993-1 biological evaluation report: biocompatibility of the contact materials (required)

blocks.zh: ISO 11608-1 測試報告 — 針具系統性能驗證（必須）
blocks.en: ISO 11608-1 test report: performance verification of the needle system (required)

blocks.zh: IEC 62366-1 可用性工程文件 — 自動注射筆的使用錯誤分析（需要）
blocks.en: IEC 62366-1 usability engineering file: use error analysis for the auto-injector pen (needed)

blocks.zh: IEC 62304 軟體生命週期文件 — 如含電子劑量追蹤功能（如適用）
blocks.en: IEC 62304 software life cycle documentation: if the device includes an electronic dose-tracking function (if applicable)

blocks.zh: 每一份文件都是ISO 14971風險管理文件的輸入或輸出，構成一個互相驗證的技術文件包。EU MDR Annex II和FDA PMA/510(k)審查官都會核查這些文件的一致性。
blocks.en: Each document is an input to or an output of the ISO 14971 risk management file, together forming a mutually verifying technical documentation package. Reviewers under EU MDR Annex II and FDA PMA/510(k) review will check the consistency of these documents.

blocks.zh: CDMO風險管理成熟度評估問題
blocks.en: CDMO Risk Management Maturity Assessment Questions

blocks.zh: 你的FMEA（IEC 60812）輸出是否已連結到ISO 14971的風險評估表格？
blocks.en: Is the output of your FMEA (IEC 60812) linked to the ISO 14971 risk assessment tables?

blocks.zh: 軟體的SFMEA（IEC 62304/IEC 62366-1）是否作為獨立輸入進入整體風險管理文件？
blocks.en: Does the software SFMEA (IEC 62304/IEC 62366-1) feed into the overall risk management file as an independent input?

blocks.zh: 生物相容性評估（ISO 10993-1）的危害識別是否出現在Annex A風險清單中？
blocks.en: Do the hazards identified in the biocompatibility evaluation (ISO 10993-1) appear in the Annex A hazard list?

blocks.zh: 你的PMS流程（ISO/TR 20416）是否有觸發機制，將新發現的危害反饋到風險管理文件更新中？
blocks.en: Does your PMS process (ISO/TR 20416) have a trigger mechanism that feeds newly identified hazards back into updates of the risk management file?

blocks.zh: 對於IVD產品，校準品的計量溯源性（ISO 17511）是否已在風險分析的「calibrator value assignment」環節中被引用？
blocks.en: For IVD products, is the metrological traceability of calibrators (ISO 17511) referenced in the "calibrator value assignment" step of the risk analysis?

blocks.zh: ISO/TR 24971書目的邊界提醒
blocks.en: Boundary Reminders for the ISO/TR 24971 Bibliography

blocks.zh: 書目中有幾個值得注意的缺口：
blocks.en: The bibliography has several gaps worth noting:

blocks.zh: EU MDR 2017/745 / IVDR 2017/746 沒有直接引用（因為ISO TR是國際標準，不引用特定地區法規）。但在實務上，這兩個法規是在歐洲使用ISO 14971的主要驅動力。
blocks.en: EU MDR 2017/745 / IVDR 2017/746 are not cited directly (because the ISO TR is an international standard and does not cite region-specific regulations). In practice, however, these two regulations are the main driver for using ISO 14971 in Europe.

blocks.zh: FDA 21 CFR 820 (QSR) / 21 CFR 803 (MDR) 同樣缺席。美國的設計管制要求與ISO 13485高度兼容，但仍有細微差異。
blocks.en: FDA 21 CFR 820 (QSR) / 21 CFR 803 (MDR) are likewise absent. US design control requirements are highly compatible with ISO 13485, but subtle differences remain.

blocks.zh: ICH Q9（品質風險管理） 未引用 — 但對CDMO同時生產藥品和器械的情境，ICH Q9與ISO 14971的對照理解是必要的。
blocks.en: ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management) is not cited, but for a CDMO that manufactures both drugs and devices, understanding how ICH Q9 and ISO 14971 correspond to each other is essential.

blocks.zh: 換言之：ISO/TR 24971給你技術框架，但法規合規要求你同時掌握地區性法規。
blocks.en: In other words: ISO/TR 24971 gives you the technical framework, but regulatory compliance requires you to master the regional regulations as well.

blocks.zh: 五個不能忘的IVD風險管理原則
blocks.en: Five IVD Risk Management Principles Not to Forget

blocks.zh: 風險序列橫跨三層：製造商、實驗室、臨床醫師 — 製造商只能直接管控第一層，但必須分析整條鏈。
blocks.en: The risk sequence spans three layers: manufacturer, laboratory, clinician. The manufacturer can directly control only the first layer, but must analyze the entire chain.

blocks.zh: P1×P2分段估算：讓技術專家估算P1（錯誤產生的概率），讓臨床專家估算P2（錯誤導致傷害的概率），兩者相乘得最終風險。
blocks.en: P1 × P2 split estimation: let technical experts estimate P1 (the probability that an error occurs) and clinical experts estimate P2 (the probability that the error leads to harm); multiplying the two gives the final risk.

blocks.zh: 危險情況的精確定義決定分析效率：對中央實驗室IVD，「錯誤結果傳到臨床醫師」是分段點；對自我測試，整條鏈由單一團隊分析。
blocks.en: A precise definition of the hazardous situation determines analysis efficiency: for central laboratory IVDs, "an erroneous result reaches the clinician" is the split point; for self-testing, a single team analyzes the whole chain.

blocks.zh: 計量溯源性是IVD準確性的基石：ISO 17511的溯源鏈確保你的校準品值可追溯到國際參考標準，這是降低P1最有效的技術手段之一。
blocks.en: Metrological traceability is the cornerstone of IVD accuracy: the ISO 17511 traceability chain ensures that your calibrator values are traceable to international reference standards, which is one of the most effective technical means of reducing P1.

blocks.zh: 標準是一個互連生態系統：ISO 14971是中心，ISO 13485是QMS框架，ISO 10993-1是生物安全輸入，ISO 11608-1是注射系統輸入，IEC 62304是軟體輸入 — 它們共同構成一個完整的技術文件包。
blocks.en: Standards form an interconnected ecosystem: ISO 14971 is the center, ISO 13485 is the QMS framework, ISO 10993-1 is the biological safety input, ISO 11608-1 is the injection system input, and IEC 62304 is the software input. Together they form a complete technical documentation package.

blocks.zh: 給CDMO同仁的行動建議
blocks.en: Recommended Actions for CDMO Colleagues

blocks.zh: 學完ISO/TR 24971全部Annex H和Bibliography，最重要的行動點是：
blocks.en: Having studied all of Annex H and the Bibliography of ISO/TR 24971, the most important action points are:

blocks.zh: 建立自己公司的「標準矩陣」：哪些標準適用於你代工的哪類產品？對應哪個法規要求？負責人是誰？
blocks.en: Build your own company's "standards matrix": which standards apply to which types of products you manufacture under contract, which regulatory requirement each corresponds to, and who is responsible?

blocks.zh: 為IVD代工建立專用FMEA模板：明確包含三層事件序列（製造商/實驗室/臨床），並標注P1與P2的分界點。
blocks.en: Build a dedicated FMEA template for IVD contract manufacturing: explicitly include the three-layer event sequence (manufacturer/laboratory/clinical) and mark the boundary between P1 and P2.

blocks.zh: 將ISO 23640穩定性研究與風險管理文件掛鉤：試劑穩定性數據不只是放行測試，它是風險分析中「reagent degradation」危害的降低措施的驗證證據。
blocks.en: Link ISO 23640 stability studies to the risk management file: reagent stability data is not just release testing; it is the verification evidence for the control measures against the "reagent degradation" hazard in the risk analysis.
